_comment: 风格 tag 预设库 — 试出来效果好的组合可以加进 presets。tags-by-category 是积木块,自由组合。

presets.indie-folk-female: indie folk, female vocal, acoustic guitar, soft drums, intimate, warm reverb, 90 bpm
presets.indie-folk-male: indie folk, male vocal, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, brush drums, melancholic, 85 bpm
presets.synthwave-80s: synthwave, 80s retro, instrumental, gated reverb drums, bright analog synth lead, driving bass, 120 bpm
presets.lofi-hiphop: lofi hip hop, instrumental, mellow piano, vinyl crackle, jazzy chords, laid back, 75 bpm
presets.pop-rock-anthem: pop rock, male vocal, distorted electric guitar, anthemic chorus, big drums, energetic, 130 bpm
presets.ambient-cinematic: ambient cinematic, instrumental, slow strings, swelling pads, ethereal, atmospheric, 60 bpm
presets.chinese-ballad: chinese ballad, female vocal, piano, strings, emotional, melancholic, slow, 70 bpm
presets.edm-festival: edm big room, instrumental, four-on-the-floor kick, supersaw lead, festival drop, 128 bpm
presets.country-acoustic: country, male vocal, acoustic guitar, banjo, harmonica, warm storytelling, 100 bpm
presets.kpop-girl-group: kpop, female vocal group, polished modern pop, catchy hook, electronic elements, 120 bpm
presets.jazz-trio: jazz trio, instrumental, walking upright bass, brush drums, piano improvisation, swing, 110 bpm
presets.rnb-slow-jam: r&b slow jam, male vocal, electric piano, soulful, smooth bass, sensual, 70 bpm

_writing_tips: 顺序: 大类型 → 人声 → 主要乐器 → 情绪 → BPM
例如: 'indie folk, female vocal, acoustic guitar, intimate, 90 bpm'
中文歌词加 'chinese lyrics mandarin' 提示更准
试出好组合就加进 presets,自己攒一个私人词典
